parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the outer frame of the clock, made of wood, providing structural support and aesthetic appeal.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the clock mechanism and surface in place, protecting internal components.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed part and does not move during operation.

parts.name: Hour Hand
parts.Basic_description: This is the hour hand of the clock, made of metal, shorter and thicker than the other hands.
parts.Functional_description: It indicates the hour on the clock face by rotating slowly around the center axis.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the central axis once every 12 hours.

parts.name: Minute Hand
parts.Basic_description: This is the minute hand of the clock, made of metal, longer and thinner than the hour hand.
parts.Functional_description: It indicates the minutes on the clock face by rotating around the center axis.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the central axis once every 60 minutes.

parts.name: Second Hand
parts.Basic_description: This is the second hand of the clock, made of metal, the thinnest and lightest of the three hands.
parts.Functional_description: It indicates the seconds on the clock face by rotating continuously around the center axis.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the central axis once every 60 seconds.

parts.name: Surface
parts.Basic_description: This is the transparent surface of the clock, made of glass, covering the hands and face.
parts.Functional_description: It protects the clock hands and face from dust and damage while allowing visibility.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed part and does not move during operation.
